_comment: Generated by scripts/build/generate-shop-catalogs.mjs from docs/story-design/story-shops.csv. DO NOT edit by hand — edit the CSV and re-run.

pokemart.name: Poké Ball
pokemart.desc: A standard ball for catching wild Pokémon.

pokemart.name: Potion
pokemart.desc: Restores 12% of max HP instantly, then 12% at the end of each of the next 2 turns. Only one healing mist at a time — the strongest active one wins.

pokemart.name: Super Potion
pokemart.desc: Restores 24% of max HP instantly, then 24% at the end of each of the next 2 turns. Only one healing mist at a time — the strongest active one wins.

pokemart.name: Hyper Potion
pokemart.desc: Restores 48% of max HP instantly, then 48% at the end of each of the next 2 turns. Only one healing mist at a time — the strongest active one wins.

pokemart.name: Max Potion
pokemart.desc: Fully restores HP of one Pokémon.

pokemart.name: Max Elixir
pokemart.desc: Fully restores PP of all moves.

pokemart.name: X Sp. Atk
pokemart.desc: +2 Sp. Attack stages for this battle.

pokemart.name: X Sp. Def
pokemart.desc: +2 Sp. Defense stages for this battle.

dept.name: Great Ball
dept.desc: A better ball with a higher catch rate than a Poké Ball.

dept.name: Revival Herb
dept.desc: Bitter remedy: revives a fainted Pokémon to 30% HP.

dept.name: Revive
dept.desc: Revives a fainted Pokémon to 50% HP.

dept.name: Max Revive
dept.desc: Revives a fainted Pokémon to full HP.

dept.name: EV Reset Charm
dept.desc: Wipes all battle training (EVs) from one Pokémon. Use when you've trained the wrong stats.
